text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of employment or education Students still at school should provide school attendance certificate, graduates who have a job should provide working certificate. Certificate should be written in English and Chinese.
